title: Progress Billing, Retainage and Payment Terms — Retrofit Project Classes
content:
# Progress Billing, Retainage and Payment Terms by Project Class

Owner billing terms for Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects. The table is the source of the billing frequency, the billing basis, the retainage rate, the retainage release period, the payment term, the monthly late fee rate, the stoppage period and the remobilisation fee of each project class.

| Project class | Billing frequency | Billing basis | Retainage withheld (per cent of each progress and change order billing) | Retainage release period (calendar days after substantial completion) | Payment term (calendar days from invoice date) | Late fee (per cent per month) | Work stopped after (calendar days past due) | Remobilisation fee after a stoppage (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Equipment Replacement Order | milestone | milestones | 0 | 0 | 15 | 1.5 | 15 | 850 |
| Planned Replacement Program | monthly | percent complete | 5 | 45 | 30 | 1.5 | 21 | 1450 |
| Controls Retrofit Project | monthly | percent complete | 10 | 45 | 30 | 1.5 | 21 | 2200 |
| Energy Retrofit Project | monthly | percent complete | 10 | 60 | 30 | 1.25 | 30 | 4200 |
| Turnkey Mechanical Upgrade Project | monthly | percent complete | 10 | 60 | 30 | 1.25 | 30 | 9500 |
| Design-Build Infrastructure Program | monthly | percent complete | 10 | 90 | 45 | 1.0 | 45 | 28000 |

## Points of reading

- Billing frequency is one of milestone, monthly or semimonthly; no current class bills semimonthly. Billing basis is one of percent complete, milestones or delivered value; no current class bills on delivered value.
- The Equipment Replacement Order withholds no retainage and therefore has no release period; its 0 in both columns is a real value, not a blank.
- The late fee column is a monthly rate on an overdue billing. Three classes charge 1.5 per cent, two charge 1.25 per cent and the Design-Build Infrastructure Program charges 1.0 per cent.
- The stoppage column is the number of calendar days past due after which work on site is stopped; the remobilisation fee is what is charged when work resumes after a stoppage for non-payment.

## Basis Q&A

**Which classes withhold retainage at 10 per cent?** The Controls Retrofit Project, the Energy Retrofit Project, the Turnkey Mechanical Upgrade Project and the Design-Build Infrastructure Program. The Planned Replacement Program withholds 5 per cent.

**Which class has the longest payment term?** The Design-Build Infrastructure Program, at 45 calendar days from the invoice date; the Equipment Replacement Order has the shortest, at 15.
